extra.question: List out top 10 Spanish drivers who were born before 1982 and have the latest lap time.
extra.evidence: born before 1982 refers to year(dob) < 1982; latest lap time refers to Max(time);
extra.question_with_evidence: List out top 10 Spanish drivers who were born before 1982 and have the latest lap time. Hint: born before 1982 refers to year(dob) < 1982; latest lap time refers to Max(time);
extra.SQL: SELECT T2.driverId FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T2.nationality = 'Spanish' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) < '1982' ORDER BY T1.time DESC LIMIT 10
